decisions.reason: Confirmed a dependency-citation applicability gap: the Definition allows every h=T/N>0 but its only justified-by theorem directly assumes h<=1. The original justification supplied no argument transferring that theorem to coarse meshes. Repaired in Remarks by normalizing time to [0,1], Brownian motion to W(Tu)/sqrt(T), drift to T b(Tu,x), and diffusion to sqrt(T) sigma(Tu,x). The normalized mesh 1/N<=1 and inherited coefficient and filtration assumptions make the theorem applicable with p=2. Its finite grid moments give finite original coefficient energy; the existing finite-step Ito lemma then supplies the original integral identity. No input or conclusion was weakened.
